displayName: Niche 4: Gia đình độc hại / Phản bội gia đình
description: Family thriller drama about toxic relatives, golden-child favoritism, mother-in-law control, sibling betrayal, inheritance theft, deed and will fraud, custody papers, adoption secrets, hidden trust funds, exile from the family home, and comeback boundaries enforced through paperwork. The engine is family blood politics and document fraud, not romance and not workplace power.
emotionalAxis: family betrayal wound, golden-child favoritism, mother-in-law / stepmother control, paperwork pressure, inheritance and custody leverage, exile and chosen family, comeback through documented boundary
coreKeywords: kicked me out of the house

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: the family closes ranks against the heroine and uses paperwork (eviction, custody, will, deed) to erase her

humiliationPacing: she is kicked out, disinherited, or erased from the family record
the family chooses the golden child publicly, in front of relatives or staff
the inheritance, custody, deed, will, or trust is weaponized against her
an outsider witnesses the family lie and is silenced by family pressure
the matriarch / stepmother makes her ask permission for what is already hers
she is told the family name is too good for her
her own work or earnings are credited to the golden child
the family asks for help while still calling her the disappointment
revengeActivation: the real will, deed, or trust deed is read in front of the family
custody, guardianship, or power-of-attorney fraud is documented and reversed
DNA or adoption records reset who legally belongs to which side
she builds an independent life and the family realizes they need her, not the other way around
a clean no-contact boundary holds even when the family begs
the chosen family (friends, mentor, lawyer, adoptive sibling) shows up where blood failed
the bank statement, signature trail, or escrow record exposes the sibling betrayal
she funds the next generation directly so the toxic branch cannot intercept the help
dignityRecoveryTiming: late, after the family is forced to admit dependence on the daughter they erased, and after the legal record is corrected on paper

belongsHere: blood family politics with golden-child favoritism and scapegoat daughter arc
inheritance / will / deed / trust fund / power-of-attorney fraud
custody, guardianship, adoption, DNA, and elder care paperwork

doesNotBelongHere: single-mom workplace and daycare drama (-> Niche 6)
